verses.ar: تَرْنِيمَةُ ٱلْمَصَاعِدِ. لِدَاوُدَ فَرِحْتُ بِٱلْقَائِلِينَ لِي: «إِلَى بَيْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ نَذْهَبُ».
verses.kjv: A Song of degrees of David. I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verses.web: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”

verses.ar: تَقِفُ أَرْجُلُنَا فِي أَبْوَابِكِ يَا أُورُشَلِيمُ.
verses.kjv: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.web: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

verses.kjv: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.web: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

verses.ar: حَيْثُ صَعِدَتِ ٱلْأَسْبَاطُ - أَسْبَاطُ ٱلرَّبِّ، شَهَادَةً لِإِسْرَائِيلَ- لِيَحْمَدُوا ٱسْمَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
verses.web: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ هُنَاكَ ٱسْتَوَتِ ٱلْكَرَاسِيُّ لِلْقَضَاءِ، كَرَاسِيُّ بَيْتِ دَاوُدَ.
verses.kjv: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.web: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

verses.kjv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.web: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

verses.ar: لِيَكُنْ سَلَامٌ فِي أَبْرَاجِكِ، رَاحَةٌ فِي قُصُورِكِ».
verses.kjv: Peace be within thy walls, [and] prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.web: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

verses.ar: مِنْ أَجْلِ إِخْوَتِي وَأَصْحَابِي لَأَقُولَنَّ: «سَلَامٌ بِكِ».
verses.kjv: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace [be] within thee.
verses.web: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

verses.ar: مِنْ أَجْلِ بَيْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِنَا أَلْتَمِسُ لَكِ خَيْرًا.
verses.kjv: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
verses.web: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.
